title: Break-ins at the homes of legacy-program colleagues from BAE

tellings.quote: >> That was happening to the people I knew who were in Legacy back at BAE in 2018.

plain: Dylan Borland, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 2018 there were break-ins at the homes of people he knew at BAE Systems, a large defence company. He says these were colleagues who worked on what he calls "Legacy", a secret programme. If true, it suggests that people tied to such programmes were being watched or pressured.
